description:
Outcome: A signed-in member chooses a court/hour, books, sees their upcoming bookings and cancels, from README and owner instructions.
Scope: Wire preview to validated booking, double-booking, quota and cancellation services; availability across the full rolling window; CSRF-protected POST forms and own-bookings screen. Excludes: other-member identity details and deferred features.
Acceptance: Complete journey works; occupied/quota/cutoff states are clear; stale availability cannot create duplicates; forged requests cannot bypass rules; cancellations update availability; all eligible hourly starts through now+168h are navigable even across eight dates.
Behaviour: Accessible labels/focus/errors/status, empty states, pending-submission feedback where relevant, safe repeated submissions, timezone labels and refreshed conflict states.
Verification: make test Django-client journey/security tests and manual keyboard walkthrough. Prerequisites: Member journey/timezone checkpoint, quota enforcement and cancellation services (slot validation and double-booking prevention transitively). Assumptions: Server-rendered forms, no SPA.
title: Live availability, booking and cancellation screens
